Experience Exceptional Dentistry at Mason Park Dental of Katy

We have an ongoing commitment to continuing education. Our team invests countless hours in learning the latest techniques and technologies in dentistry. At Mason Park Dental, you will benefit from our state-of-the-art facilities.

We use accurate, efficient, and modern equipment to ensure your comfort at all times. Some of our advanced dental technologies include Cone Beam Imaging, Digital X-Rays, Intral-Oral Camera, and Soft Tissue Laser. Visit our Technology page for more information.
Dentistry for every stage of life
You are important to us. For your convenience, we provide a wide range of dental solutions in our local Katy location. Some of these options include preventative, restorative, and cosmetic dentistry.

Our friendly, knowledgeable team will address every question and concern. Your oral health needs, goals, and priorities are the focus of your customized treatment plan. We want to work with you to create the beautiful, healthy smile of your dreams. With our advanced technology, our team will provide you with the most comfortable and comprehensive treatment specific to your needs.

Dr. Sung, Dr. Cho, and Dr. Nguyen, Katy dentists, are committed to providing you with excellent dentistry in a comfortable environment. You deserve a skilled, experienced dental team that can help you ensure great oral health.

Your dental care experience is fully personalized at Mason Park Dental. Our friendly, knowledgeable team will address every question and concern. Your oral health needs, goals, and priorities are the focus of your customized treatment plan. We want to work with you to create the beautiful, healthy smile of your dreams.
Come experience what patient-centered care can do for you. We welcome new patients of all ages.

The team here is so wonderful. Very caring. They made me smile, especially Dr. Sung, Caisy and Nusrat. I really recommend this place. My first time here and I am so loving it. When I came back for my cleaning, Angela and Abigail were super nice

I was recommend by another dentist who didn’t accept my insurance anymore. First time experience was amazing, went in for a cleaning with Genevieve and she was amazing. She was very informing and kind with what she was doing. Will continue to keep coming back :)

Tiffany was “extremely” informative with regards to providing critical information for my dental care. She kept me informed with everything she was doing and answered all my questions. This was one of the BEST dental experience I’ve had. Thanks for the exceptional services provided!!!! “

I always have a great experience coming here. I have extensive dental work that Dr. Cho and his team have been rectifying. They try to make it as painless and as comfortable as possible during my visits. I don’t feel the usual fear and anxiety that comes with visiting a dentist. Genevieve is a great dental hygienist. She did a great job with my cleaning. It helps that they all have very comforting voices that puts you, the patient at ease; you might be lulled to sleep. Highly recommend. “

Tiffany was a dream with my 5 year old son! She was a natural with my son and he was so good with her. She has a great personality and makes the experience more of a fun time rather than am actual appointment! Dr Cho the main Dr was soooo good with my son engaged and made him feel safe as they both did I wouldn’t take my son anywhere else. Thank you for amazing customer service and bed side mannor.. you help make a scary experience really fun for kids thanks for that!! “

Everyone there is very nice. They were able to see my son within a day of calling. My son had a horrible experience with an extraction as a little boy and he was nervous to have a tooth pulled again. They made him feel at ease. Afterwards he said he didn’t feel a thing. “
